metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Pick the economic indicators you want (US national, monthly). Each becomes its own time series.

seriesIds.title: BLS series IDs (advanced)
seriesIds.description: For power users: paste raw BLS series IDs, one per line (e.g. "LNS14000000"). Find them at data.bls.gov. Combined with the metrics above.

endYear.title: End year
endYear.description: Last year of data. Without a BLS key the range is capped at 10 years (20 with a key).

registrationKey.title: BLS API key (optional)
registrationKey.description: Optional: your own free BLS registration key. Raises the shared daily limit (25 queries/day per IP) to 500/day and allows more series and a wider year range. Register free at data.bls.gov/registrationEngine.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
